text:
carla: CI red on `unit/golden/snapshots` — seeing a bunch of small diffs that look like serialization changes. job: https://ci.redwood.example/987654/results. Can someone kick a rerun? I'm on call but out for a bit :grimacing:

ci-bot: [CI] job `unit/golden/snapshots` failed (run 987654). failing tests: tests/golden/prompt_echo::test_prompt_echo, tests/golden/formatting::test_escape_behavior

dave: pinging @alice since she last touched prompt snapshot infra. quick look at the artifact shows `\x0b` got escaped to `\u000b` in the actual output — maybe the JSON serializer was updated in runtime lib. :thinking:

alice: thanks — can you paste a tiny diff? I can try to repro locally.

carla: small excerpt from the golden diff in the artifact:

```
- expected: "Hello\x0bWorld"
+ actual:   "Hello\\u000bWorld"
```

carla: also noticed one other case where trailing spaces in structured outputs got an extra escape sequence.

brian: to repro quickly you can pull the artifact and run the snapshot comparator locally: `python infra/tools/compare_snapshots.py --artifact 987654 --filter prompt_echo`

alice: trying local now. if it's a serializer change it's probably from the recent jsonpatch bump (rev def456 -> ghi789). quick bisect suggestion:

```
git bisect start ghi789 def456
git bisect run ./scripts/run_golden_smoke.sh prompt_echo
```

alice: if someone can kick a CI rerun meanwhile that helps rule out flaky infra — @devops-bot can you queue?

devops-bot: forced rerun requested for job 987654 by dave. new run: https://ci.redwood.example/987661 (queued)

carla: thanks — if the rerun passes we mark as flake, otherwise we'll bisect.

dave: note: if bisect points to the json library, a quick temporary workaround is to normalize the serializer in the comparator before comparing (unescape `\\u000b` -> `\x0b`) — not ideal but buys time for a proper fix.

alice: confirmed local reproduce on commit ghi789. bisect indicates last good at def456. I'll open a tiny PR to adjust the serializer config and add a golden test that covers control-char serialization.

brian: when you open the PR, include a regression test and a note for release notes (serialization tweak could affect downstream snapshots). I'll review. :thumbsup:

carla: perfect. marking this thread as triaged — alice will own the PR and follow up with links here. thanks everyone for the quick help.

alice: opening PR now: https://git.redwood.example/p/redwood/infra/merge_requests/1234 — includes fix and two new golden tests. will merge after CI green.
